scripts.test:app: wdio run e2e/app/wdio.conf.ts; solo=$?; REKINDLE_APP_NO_BUILD=1 wdio run e2e/app/wdio.peers.conf.ts; peers=$?; REKINDLE_APP_NO_BUILD=1 wdio run e2e/app/wdio.native.conf.ts; native=$?; REKINDLE_APP_NO_BUILD=1 wdio run e2e/app/wdio.budget.conf.ts; budget=$?; echo "test:app: solo exit $solo, peers exit $peers, native exit $native, budget exit $budget"; [ $solo -eq 0 ] && [ $peers -eq 0 ] && [ $native -eq 0 ] && [ $budget -eq 0 ]
scripts.test:app:devices: wdio run e2e/app/wdio.devices.conf.ts; solo=$?; REKINDLE_APP_NO_BUILD=1 wdio run e2e/app/wdio.devices-peers.conf.ts; peers=$?; echo "test:app:devices: solo exit $solo, peers exit $peers"; [ $solo -eq 0 ] && [ $peers -eq 0 ]
